name: Fluxwing Skills
headline: Fluxwing Skills - Rapid ASCII Design
short_description: Fluxwing Skills enables rapid iterative design using ASCII components. Operations teams can create low-fidelity layouts quickly, then refine them with AI assistance. Connects to Claude for AI-driven design iteration and human review.
author: trabian

sections.overview:
Fluxwing Skills is an AI-powered design tool that enables progressive fidelity workflows starting with ASCII layouts. The skill set includes six specialized tools: component creator, library browser, screen scaffolder, component expander, viewer, and screenshot importer. Teams can iterate designs through natural language conversation with Claude, moving from low-fidelity ASCII mockups to structured component metadata. All outputs save to your project workspace as .uxm metadata files and .md ASCII templates, following the uxscii open standard. This approach lets you validate design decisions quickly at low-fidelity before investing in high-fidelity builds.
Create reusable button, input, card, and modal components in minutes
Build complete UI screens by composing components through conversation
Add interactive states (hover, focus, disabled, error) to existing components
Convert screenshots into uxscii ASCII components for rapid prototyping
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/trabian/fluxwing-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Create a low-fidelity ASCII layout for a [COMPANY] data center in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include [NUMBER] racks, [NUMBER] servers per rack, and [NUMBER] network switches. Then suggest 3 improvements to optimize airflow and cable management. Use this layout: [ASCII_LAYOUT].
```
Copy

```
# Data Center Layout for GreenTech Solutions

```
+---------------------+
| RACK-01 (12 Servers) |
+---------+-----------+
| NET-SW-01 | NET-SW-02 |
+---------------------+
| RACK-02 (12 Servers) |
+---------+-----------+
| NET-SW-03 | NET-SW-04 |
+---------------------+
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
